gloss: to shudder; to tremble with fear; to be horrified

definitions.gloss: to shudder; to tremble with fear; to be horrified
definitions.explanation: To feel an intense chill or trembling from fear, horror, or shock at something terrifying or appalling.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{戦慄|せんりつ}した。
⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{残忍|ざんにん}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I felt a shudder at the cruelty of the crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}った→知る：00458_shiru⟧とき、⟦{背筋|せすじ}→背筋：13931_sesuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}る→凍る：02100_kooru⟧ような⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: When I learned the truth, a spine-chilling shudder ran through me.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧ (shuddering; horror) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. A literary, dramatic word frequently used in horror fiction, news about shocking crimes, and dramatic storytelling. More intense than simply being scared — implies a physical reaction of trembling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel a shudder of horror
- ⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: a shudder runs through (someone)
- ⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧すべき: horrifying; shudder-inducing
- ⟦{戦慄|せんりつ}→戦慄：16426_senritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: a horrifying fact

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to tremble; to shiver — the basic word for physical trembling from cold, fear, or excitement
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fear; to be frightened — focuses on the emotion of fear rather than the physical trembling
- ⟦ぞっと→ぞっと：05272_zotto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shudder; to get the creeps — more colloquial; used for a momentary chill of fear or disgust
